resources.string: Records what each connected controller sends, to a file you can share, so a controller the app doesn\'t fully support yet can be mapped. Keep the virtual gamepad off while recording.
No controller yet: scan and connect, and each one is recorded as it connects.
Put every controller down and leave it untouched for 3 seconds.
Press A, then B, then X, then Y, one at a time.
Press up, down, left, then right.
Press L, R, ZL, then ZR (Z on a GameCube controller). Press L and R all the way in.
Press −, + (Start), Home, Capture, then C. Skip any your controller doesn\'t have.
Click the left stick, then the right. Skip if your controller has none.
Press GL, then GR. Skip if your controller has none.
Push it up, down, left and right, each to the edge and back, then roll it once round the edge.
The same with the right stick (the C-stick on a GameCube controller).
Press L slowly all the way down over about 3 seconds, then let it back up just as slowly. Skip if L only clicks.
Press L to the first stop you can feel and hold it there for 2 seconds.
Press L through to the second stop, hold it for 2 seconds, then let go.
Press R slowly all the way down over about 3 seconds, then let it back up just as slowly. Skip if R only clicks.
Press R to the first stop you can feel and hold it there for 2 seconds.
Press R through to the second stop, hold it for 2 seconds, then let go.
Use every connected controller at once for a minute, as you would in a game, then tap Finish.
